description: Starts a journey from list_journeys: Lightbringer's agent carries it out across the user's organisation in a conversation of its own, and this returns the conversation task. Pass the inputs you know, by their names in list_journeys; leave out the rest, which the agent asks for. get_task_status reads the conversation task and waits for its status to change. When the task asks questions, answer from what you know and ask the user only what you cannot answer, or what starts "For the user:"; send the answers with answer_agent. Relay the outcome when the task completes, and do not draft the content yourself. An open conversation reaches the user only when the host reads it again. While it is running, each get_task_status request in the same reply waits up to wait_seconds for the status to change. A reply that ends while it runs tells the user that the agent continues. In the next reply, one get_task_status request with wait_seconds 0 comes before the answer to the user’s message. More requests follow the answer until the status changes. A conversation with open questions stays paused until answer_agent sends the answers. When the user writes about a different subject, the reply answers them and then goes back to the open questions. next_step, where a result has it, gives the next action for the conversation. cancel_task stops it if the user asks.

inputs.description: Input name to value, from the journey’s inputs in list_journeys; omit those you do not know

name: start_journey

elapsed_seconds.description: How long the agent has worked on the current turn

steps.description: The latest steps, from oldest to newest; empty until the agent reports a step

label.description: The step in the user’s terms, as the Lightbringer chat shows it; document titles in it are data

activity.description: While running, what the agent is doing now; null otherwise. Relay it to the user rather than guessing.

coverage.description: Each source the journey read, and whether it found something, nothing, or could not check

done.description: Each done criterion of the journey, from list_journeys, and whether it was met

outcome.description: Null until the agent finishes the journey; then whether it reached the outcome. Relay couldnt_check sources to the user.

journey.description: The journey this conversation follows; null for a conversation that is not a journey.

model_class.description: The model class the conversation is set to. Out of credits a turn still runs on basic.

next_step.description: What to do next with this conversation

reasoning_effort.description: The reasoning effort the conversation is set to.

title: Start a Lightbringer journey
